changelog: - **Fewer steps and hooks in automatic lines.** Dashed lines on different sides of one node were wrongly routed as one bundle, which gave them small steps or hooks next to the node; they are now routed per side, so those steps and hooks are reduced. A node where one side has a dashed line coming in and one going out keeps the earlier bundling. A line whose first bend point sits right by its port now leaves straight to it. Not every automatic-line problem is solved: a line leaving a node's bottom can still go round that node's own name when all four sides of the node have connections, and one pickup-gacha line keeps a detour.
